records.title: File:Two French bulldogs swimming in life jackets.jpg
records.description: Two French bulldogs swimming in life jackets in the water at Sandvik beach by Brofjorden, Lysekil Municipality, Sweden. These two dogs were very happily swimming and cooling off in the water on a hot summer's day. Because of this breed's constitution, they can't really hold their head high over the surface and this may result in inhaling water and drowning. Responsable owners put life vests on their French bulldogs to help them get the right buoyancy.
